page.layout: One column of running text, set in a single block. Running head above the text at top centre, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Headings XXXIX, XL and XLI are bare numbers, set as paragraphs.

main_text.l: historias Scripturarum & non sensum spiritua-
lem aut voluntatem earum, & adhuc detra-
hunt eis qui Christo confurrexerũt[?] & quae
sur-sum sunt in Scripturis requirunt, & non super
terram, nec in terrenis Scripturarum positam
existimant veritatem: eludunt quantum ad se
ante homines regnum coelorum, eludentes
illud iniustitia sua, & trahentes ad se eos qui po-
terant, audientes diuiniorem & maiorem
doctrinam & altitudinem veritatis, intrare per
coelestes doctrinas & per convenientes eis a-
ctus in regnum coelorum. Tract.25.in Matth.
XXXIX.
Frequenter consideranda sunt huiusmodi
homines, qui in rebus leuissimis religionem su-
am ostentant. Rectè eos Christus hypocritas
appellat. Volentes enim religiositatem acqui-
rere coram hominibus, nolunt suscipere religi-
ositatem illam quam Deus iustificauit. Ibidem.
XL.
[?]ices funt à foris, quasi mundati propter
speciem religionis quam simulant: ab intus au-
tem pleni rapina & seductione, quibus homi-
nes rapiunt ad errorem, & lupi rapaces sub pel-
libus ouium latitantes, & simplicium animas
devorantes, qui videre non possunt eos esse lu-
pos rapaces propter ouilium pellium tegumé-
tum. Ibidem.

page.notes: The large initial at the start of the XL paragraph is partly covered by a dark blot; the first letter is read as [?]. The word "religi-ositatem" and "tegumé-tum" at line ends are uncertain in the hyphenation. "confurrexerũt" carries a doubtful mark over the final vowel. The reference "Tract.25.in Matth." sits as a line-end italic reference, not as a marginal note.
